overall_goal: Prepare the cooking area, add and melt oils in the pressure cooker, and measure out the green peas

goals.description: Prepare the cooking area and retrieve the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person clears the workspace and takes the pressure cooker out of the cabinet.

goals.description: Add oil and ghee to the pressure cooker and log the amount
goals.rationale: The person pours olive oil and ghee into the cooker and writes down the measurements in a notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve and wash the wooden spatula
goals.rationale: The person searches the drawers for a wooden spatula, washes it under the tap, and dries it.

goals.description: Turn on the electric hob and position the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person plugs in the electric hob, turns it on, sets the temperature, and places the cooker on the burner.

goals.description: Melt the ghee and stir the oil in the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person uses the wooden spatula to break apart the ghee clumps and stir the oils as they heat up.

goals.description: Close the olive oil bottle and retrieve spices
goals.rationale: The person puts the lid back on the olive oil bottle, moves it away, and picks up a plate of spices.

goals.description: Log recipe notes in the notebook
goals.rationale: The person opens the notebook and writes down notes about the dish being cooked.

goals.description: Set up the weighing scale and serving bowl
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a serving bowl from the cabinet and places it on the weighing scale to prepare for measuring.

goals.description: Scoop and measure the green peas
goals.rationale: The person uses a tumbler to scoop frozen peas from their container into the serving bowl on the scale until the desired weight is reached.

goals.description: Log the measured amount of green peas and clear the scale
goals.rationale: The person writes down the weight of the peas in the notebook, removes the bowl, and turns off the scale.

goals.description: Stir and check the contents of the pressure cooker
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up and puts down the spatula to check on the heating oils in the pressure cooker.

goals.description: Organize ingredients and utensils for the next steps
goals.rationale: The person moves various items around the counter, such as a knife, tablespoon, mortar, and salt jar, to prepare for cooking.
